subject: english
title: Roots: Clean, Sing, Slow
objective: Identify the base words clean, sing, and slow in common related words.
introduction: Hi Maxine! 🌱 A base word is like a root. Today's roots: clean, sing, and slow. Let's see how new words grow from them!

vocabulary.definition: to make something free of dirt
to make music with your voice

items.prompt: Which pair shows a root word and a related word?
items.explanation: Clean is the root, and cleaned is the same word with -ed added.

items.prompt: Which is the base word in 'cleaned'?
items.explanation: Take the -ed off cleaned and clean is left — that is the base word.

items.prompt: Which word was made from the root 'clean'?
items.explanation: Cleaned is clean with -ed added, so it grew from the root clean.

items.prompt: Which pair does NOT belong with the others?
items.explanation: "cat — dog" names two animals, not a word family. The other pairs share a base word and a related word.

items.prompt: What is the root word of 'singer'?
items.explanation: Singer is sing with -er added, so the root word is sing.
